review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Restore missing saved sessions remotely with explicit preview and durable once-only worker; retain menu progress
review.notes: User authorized App remote restoration and menu progress. All verification uses isolated fixtures; no actual old-session restore, live pane input, App/service restart or deployment. Reuse existing saved-layout/agent evidence and strict identity guards. Remote execution is headless even on macOS; never attaches/opens a local terminal. Only missing saved sessions approved by preview may receive agent startup; live existing sessions are untouched. Read/start/status are owner-only. Snapshot binds full underlying save+record/config/topology data, not just display names. POST persists reservation before detached child launch; stable time-prefixed request ID expires for NEW admissions after24h; receipts retained48h, at most128, unexpired receipts never evicted for capacity. Same ID returns existing result before comparing changed topology; changed payload conflicts. Corrupt/private-storage failure refuses, never starts. Process-owned leases serialize all CLI/menu/remote execution without stale-age takeover; child claim is once-only and survives HTTP loss. Interrupted/unknown never auto-runs again. Finished means worker ended; confirmed/pending/partial/layout failures stay distinct. Client reopens with status reads, never retries mutation on mount or network recovery. Preserve existing CLI desktop semantics outside the remote worker. Bound worker30min, metadata IO, preview256sessions/2048 agent results and replies. Native permission attribution remains existing --from-app bootstrap policy. Web has no new restore UI in this change; API is transport-independent owner contract; document five-surface decision. 403 is not presumed a session-count quota; current evidence lacks pane26 admission reason, so no relaxation/automatic retry on hard identity refusal.

cases.setup: Authenticated real Handler with fake preview/status/start callbacks
cases.action: GET preview/status, POST stable id+revision; guest, methods, malformed/unknown/oversize fields
cases.expected: Reads never start work; only owner may start; strict bounded schema; stale/changed/uncertain codes preserved

cases.description: Durable idempotent restore reservations and worker ownership
cases.setup: Actual restorejob.Store under isolated HOME with deterministic clock/launch seam
cases.action: Concurrent same ID, other ID, changed revision, late retry, launch failure, restart/read, storage failure, expired IDs and bounded capacity
cases.expected: Persist before launch; one launch per request; same ID never relaunches even after failure/interruption; active blocks another ID; unavailable storage refuses; expired IDs cannot become new work

cases.setup: Production app projection over synthetic saved/live topology, original pending plan builder with injected tmux queries
cases.action: Mix missing/live-detached/attached; unreadable topology, save/config/identity changes, zero/many sessions
cases.expected: Remote preview includes only missing saved sessions; existing detached sessions remain usable and are not restarted; revision binds save bytes, records/mode, and topology; unknown refuses; cap fails explicitly

cases.description: Remote worker preserves restore safety and honest results
cases.setup: Production worker with injected plan/prepare/live/resume hooks; isolated kernel execution lease
cases.action: Stale revision, duplicate worker, busy CLI lease, layout failure, mixed confirmed/pending/skipped results and late phase updates
cases.expected: No mutation before claim+lease+fresh matching preview; no terminal/focus; resumptions limited to approved newly missing sessions; no existing program restart; pending is not confirmed; final result persisted once, write error stops before further input

cases.description: Process lease shared by CLI and remote worker
cases.setup: Production execution lease in isolated state; actual CLI dry-run fixture and lease contention
cases.action: Two contenders, holder release/process exit and IO failure
cases.expected: At most one restore mutation producer; unavailable lease fails closed; no age-based takeover of a live holder; dry-run/read preview still read-only

cases.description: Client restore response validation and bounded mutation
cases.setup: Real GtmuxClient and controlled fetch with normal request timeout
cases.action: Read/start/status; timeout, unsupported server, malformed result, wrong request/host and explicit same-ID retry
cases.expected: No automatic mutation retry or channel fallback; stable ID/revision transmitted; bounded parsing; reads cannot start; unsupported is actionable

cases.description: Rendered remote restore journey and reconnect
cases.setup: Actual RestoreSessionsSheet with injected client and fake network/timers; normal SheetShell
cases.action: Preview then confirm; duplicate clicks; response loss, close/reopen, host switch, late old reply, offline/guest/old server and partial result
cases.expected: Nothing starts on mount/refresh; explicit confirm starts once; progress reattaches by read on reopen; unknown only checks status using same ID; no cross-host late update/mutation; failure not success; no polling after close

cases.action: Dispatch restore closing policy, activation, reopen during restore, explicit Escape/outside close and other actions
cases.expected: Restore bypasses generic close, keeps progress without focus theft/reopen; explicit close wins; all other actions retain their behavior
